goal.objective: Through 2026-09-08 00:47 UTC (24 hours from this session's start), work in experiments/v6/sep07_compositions_v0/ to develop the strongest practical C++ Kaggriculture agent using a composition-first strategy search and a repeatable league-improvement loop. A composition describes which crops and animals exist, how many, and during which days; policies may choose different composition continuations from observed shops, prices, public opponent state, and their own execution state. Test the hypothesis that these economic lifecycles, combined with productive service practices learned from top players, allow strategy value to be estimated much faster than simulating exact worker movements. Build a fast estimator that covers dated biology and output, greedy but improvable placement, feasibility, labor and approximate service routes, wheat and fertilizer supply, land, cash, storage, endogenous market impact, and earliest practical purchase/deposit/sale times. Evaluate good initial proposals and alternative suffixes across many shop scenarios against modeled compositions and real opponents. Use search depth, reusable day templates, pruning or alternative algorithms only when they improve measured speed and decision quality. Compile promising compositions into complete observation-driven policies using a day solver and local placement, routing, workforce and intraday purchase/sale optimization. Compare estimated strength with exact full-game results, identify whether errors come from economics, estimation, compilation or runtime repairs, and improve those components accordingly. Continually pull and analyze recent replays of globally strong players for useful openings, compositions, service practices, placement and trade patterns. Maintain a diverse growing league containing the strongest teammate agents in external/, strong available Kaggle C++ agents, and prior versions developed in this session. Repeatedly search strategies that beat current opponents, compile them, test them on common seeds and both seats, retain useful distinct versions, and challenge them against the broader league and unused audit scenarios. Aim for an agent that beats the strongest teammate, public and previous-session-version opponents; report measured gaps honestly if that has not been achieved. Preserve cold starts, family insertion/deletion, large composition rebuilds and shop/opponent-dependent branches so the search can escape one strategy family. Every 20 minutes review progress and reprioritize the ideas ledger or pivot, including deep comparisons with top-player animal/crop milestones, service per animal-day, output, purchases, sales, net flows, timing, labor, land, fertilizer, weeds, faults and discards. Separate actual production gains from transaction inflation and accept changes through common-seed causal ablations and exact promotion gates. Measure bottlenecks and improve or redesign slow stages; C++ CPU estimation/search is the default, and GPU work is justified only by an actual suitable workload. Keep all sources, scripts, replay data, diagnostics, versions, ledgers and reproducible artifacts self-contained in the requested experiment, using only permitted persistent repository resources. Follow repository instructions, do not use Git, and do not submit externally without an explicit submission request. End with the strongest validated complete agent, runnable improvement loop, evaluation evidence and clear remaining limitations.
